stem: A bench shows slower dryback, lower oxygen-related root vigor, and standing drainage water beneath several containers while irrigation output matches target. What is the strongest Technician I handoff?
choices: Document the wet root-zone pattern, standing water, plant observations, and verified delivery so drainage/root-zone conditions can be investigated
Increase irrigation because output is on target
Ignore the drainage water because irrigation output passed
rationale: Verified delivery does not rule out drainage or root-zone problems. The technician should preserve the combined evidence and escalate for investigation.
